items.title: Bright White Kitchen with Open Wooden Shelves
items.description: A bright white kitchen with floating wooden shelves, colourful cast-iron pots and clear worktops. A budget-friendly way to add storage and warmth.

image.alt: Bright white kitchen with floating wooden shelves holding red pots, a gas hob with a red casserole dish and white cabinets

items.title: Luxury Kitchen with a Marble Island and Breakfast Bar
items.description: A luxury kitchen layout built around a marble-topped island with walnut panelling, leather stools and a statement range hood.

image.alt: Large white kitchen with a marble-topped island, walnut panelling, three leather bar stools and a stainless steel range hood

items.title: Fresh Spring Kitchen Corner with a DIY Herb Garden
items.description: Bring spring into a small kitchen with a windowsill herb garden, a brass tap and greenery by the sink. A simple seasonal DIY idea.

image.alt: Kitchen sink corner with a brass tap, fresh herbs and leafy greens on a white worktop, grey cabinets and a bowl of apples

items.title: Two-Tone Kitchen: Charcoal Base Cabinets and White Subway Tiles
items.description: A two-tone kitchen pairing charcoal lower cabinets with white subway tiles, open wood shelves and brass accents. A modern colour combination.

image.alt: Kitchen with charcoal grey lower cabinets, white subway tile walls, open wooden shelves and a cream ceiling light
